Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The list of situations where you need not stop for a school bus begins on physical page 83 and continues on page 84 in the next section; only the first item, the off-road loading zone, is taught here [A09].
The manual says a school bus with red or amber lights flashing requires a stop for as long as it is stopped or preparing to stop; the dossier reports that exactly and does not separate the meanings of the two light colors [A08].
The DDI performance claims are the manual's own statements without a cited study, so no figures are added [A05].
The RCUT text refers to a red movement in a figure; the dossier describes only the printed maneuver, a right turn followed by a U-turn at a one-way median opening [A06].
